# Third-party source excerpts

The root MIT license applies only to original code and text in this
repository.  Files in `third_party/e160/` are short, attributed excerpts
included to document the problem statement and nearby literature.  They
are not relicensed under MIT and remain subject to the rights and terms of
their respective sources.

The excerpt URLs, retrieval information, source roles, and payload hashes are
recorded in `docs/source/source_audit.md`.  SHA-256 hashes for the local
excerpts are listed in `third_party/e160/SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_MANIFEST.tsv`.
